profile: standard normalization: a very simple two-step procedure by which the input features of a dataset are first mean-centered and then re-scaled by the inverse of their standard deviation. It should be applied to the input features of a dataset prior to optimization. Using standard normalization to scale input is highly advantageous when employing gradient descent schemes.
